name: Wan2.1
tagline: Open-source text-to-video and image-to-video diffusion model family capable of running on consumer 8GB VRAM GPUs.
real_test_summary: Tested the 1.3B parameter text-to-video checkpoint locally via ComfyUI on consumer hardware. Generates clean, watermark-free vertical and landscape clips completely offline.
pros: 1.3B variant runs locally on 8GB VRAM consumer graphics cards
Permissive Apache-2.0 license allows unrestricted commercial video output
Native integration into ComfyUI workflows for image-to-video control
cons: 14B high-resolution model requires 24GB+ VRAM or heavy quantization
Rendering multi-second clips takes several minutes per generation
